verdict: Yes, for a technical team. Kibo by TrestleLabs pitched optical character recognition software on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Reading printed text in Indian languages and converting it to audio or digital text helps visually impaired users, schools and government offices.
angle: Documents in Indian languages are still mostly on paper. OCR that handles many scripts helps libraries, schools and offices digitise records, and helps visually impaired people read. Institutions and CSR budgets are key buyers.
